candidates.title: Shapefile of Rivers
candidates.issuer: National Water Informatics Centre, Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti

discovery.evidence: Official OGD resource HTML was fetched successfully (1,010,899 bytes). Its publisher metadata identifies the resource title, catalog, original URL, application/zip format, advertised size 10,660,764 bytes and a nationwide line-layer description. The parent catalog says it is released under NDSAP.

evidence: The OGD parent catalog marks this collection Released Under: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP).

The OGD portal states that published data is licensed under Government Open Data License - India; that license describes copying, distribution, adaptation and publication subject to attribution and other terms.

OGD Terms of Use directs users to the license metadata element on individual dataset records. This resource's field_data_licence is empty, so the catalog-level NDSAP label and portal-wide GO-DL statement do not establish an unambiguous resource-level license attachment for strict admission.

download.observation: The official download request followed the response into a redirect loop (curl limit 50). No ZIP file was created; reported redirect-body bytes are not source data.

candidates.permissionAndUse: Unresolved for strict source admission; no source bytes were acquired or redistributed.

candidates.title: Boundaries of Agro-Ecological Regions
candidates.issuer: National Water Informatics Centre, Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti

discovery.evidence: The official OGD search record advertises a 3.3 MB ZIP of nationwide region boundaries; the resource page did not load through either official host form, so resource-specific terms and a direct original URL were unavailable.

outcome.concreteGap: No candidate produced inspectable original bytes within the two-attempt limit. The directly downloadable NWIC Rivers record advertises a 10,660,764-byte ZIP but its official file URL loops through redirects; its resource-level license field is empty, leaving strict use/redistribution admission unresolved. The two official alternatives also redirected repeatedly before resource bytes and resource-level terms could be established. A stable official download response and an unambiguous resource-linked use/redistribution license are needed before acquisition and format-aware inspection.

limitations: No original source hash, actual byte size, features, parts, positions, extent, identifiers, CRS or vertical reference could be verified from bytes.
No source-derived fixture, manifest, acquisition checker, runtime ingestion or benchmark was created.
No 3D city, parcel, ownership, legal-boundary, measurement, runtime or GF-SCALE-1 claim is qualified.
